name: Catfall
text: Halves the distance counted when falling or jumping down, and may pass an Initiative test to stay standing after a fall. Zone Mortalis boards are flat and nobody falls in v1, so it has no effect.

name: Clamber
text: Climbing is not halved in cost. There is no climbing on a flat Zone Mortalis board in v1, so it has no effect.

name: Dodge
text: A 6+ save that nothing can modify, usable against ranged and close combat attacks in addition to the armour save. Against Blast and template attacks a passed save lets the fighter step up to 2 inches before it is decided whether it is hit.

name: Mighty Leap
text: Ignores the first 2 inches of a gap when leaping it. There are no gaps to leap on a flat Zone Mortalis board in v1, so it has no effect.

name: Spring Up
text: A Pinned fighter that is activated may pass an Initiative test to stand up for free.

name: Sprint
text: In an activation with two or more Move actions, the final Move uses twice the Movement characteristic.

name: Bull Charge
text: When charging, the fighter's melee weapons gain Knockback and +1 Strength.

name: Bulging Biceps
text: Lets an Unwieldy melee weapon be wielded one-handed, so a second melee weapon can accompany it. The weapon still occupies two slots, and Unwieldy ranged weapons get no benefit.

name: Crushing Blow
text: Before rolling to hit, nominate one attack that is not a Sidearm attack; if it connects it gains +1 Strength and +1 Damage.

name: Headbutt
text: Free action against an Engaged enemy in base contact. Roll 2D6: should either die reach the target's Toughness, the blow connects at Strength +2 and Damage 2. Should both dice come up short, the fighter wounds itself with a hit at its own Strength and Damage 1.

name: Hurl
text: Can replace the free Fight that follows a charge, or be done later as a Basic action. The target is either an enemy locked in base contact with the fighter or a Seriously Injured enemy no more than 1 inch away. Unless that enemy passes an Initiative test, the fighter shifts it D3 inches in any direction; it stops against another standing fighter or terrain. The enemy and whatever it bumps are hit at Strength 3 and Pinned.

name: Iron Jaw
text: Adds 2 to Toughness against close combat attacks whose AP is "-".

name: Combat Master
text: Ignores interference and always counts as giving an assist in melee.

name: Counter-attack
text: Reaction attacks gain one extra Attack for every attack the opponent made that missed.

name: Disarm
text: The fighter's melee weapons gain Disarm on a 6+ to hit; weapons that already have Disarm trigger on a 5+.

name: Parry
text: Counts as carrying one extra Parry weapon, so one more attack can be parried.

name: Rain of Blows
text: The Fight (Basic) action becomes a Fight (Simple) action.

name: Step Aside
text: Each time the fighter is hit in close combat it may pass an Initiative test to avoid the hit, once against each enemy per round of combat.

name: Berserker
text: +1 Attack when charging.

name: Fearsome
text: An enemy declaring a charge on this fighter must first pass a Willpower test; failing it ends that enemy's action.

name: Impetuous
text: Consolidates up to 4 inches instead of 2.

name: Nerves of Steel
text: Hit by a ranged attack, the fighter may pass a Cool test to avoid becoming Pinned.

name: True Grit
text: One fewer Injury die is rolled for this fighter; when that would leave none, two dice are rolled and one is discarded.

name: Unstoppable
text: Ahead of a Recovery test roll a D6: on 4+ a Flesh Wound is removed, or, with no Flesh Wounds, the Recovery test gets an extra die and one die is dropped.

name: Commanding Presence
text: Group Activation +1.

name: Inspirational
text: A friendly fighter within 6 inches that fails a Cool test can be rescued: this fighter passes a Leadership test and the failed test counts as passed.

name: Iron Will
text: Subtracts 1 from the gang's Bottle roll for as long as this fighter is on the battlefield and neither Seriously Injured nor Wrecked.

name: Mentor
text: Lets this fighter pass a Leadership test to give a nearby friend one extra XP. Campaign only, so it has no effect in v1.

name: Overseer
text: Double action (Order), only while Active. Pass a Leadership test to have a friendly fighter within 6 inches activate immediately and take two actions even if not Ready; that fighter's Ready status stays as it was.

name: Regroup
text: A fighter still Active when its activation ends may pass a Leadership test to rally every Broken friend within 6 inches.
